name: Manager change mid-month
description: Validate split manager credit when manager changes during month
expected_behavior: Transactions before change stay with prior manager and after change with new manager
known_failure_mode: prior manager gets full month credit

name: Territory reassignment mid-month
description: Validate credit split on territory reassignment date
expected_behavior: Transactions are credited by effective assignment without overlap or gaps
known_failure_mode: double-credit or zero credit on reassignment date

name: Quota adjusted mid-period
description: Validate pro-rated or revised quota handling after change
expected_behavior: System uses revised quota logic only for effective range
known_failure_mode: original quota used for full period

name: Rep on LOA partial month
description: Validate proration for leave of absence partial month
expected_behavior: Only active business days contribute to credit and attainment

name: New hire starts last day of month
description: Validate interaction between new-hire draw and proration for start-date edge
expected_behavior: Draw and proration rules apply without duplicate protection logic issues
known_failure_mode: draw triggers AND full proration credit both applied

name: Two reps share same territory same day
description: Validate split-credit logic for same-day territory overlap
expected_behavior: Credit is split per policy rather than assigned entirely to one rep
known_failure_mode: one rep gets full credit instead of split

name: Manager rep leaves mid-month
description: Validate rollup stops at departure date for departed rep
expected_behavior: Only in-period active rep transactions roll up to manager
known_failure_mode: departed rep transactions roll up for full month

name: Bonus goal revised after period start
description: Validate bonus trigger against revised goal effective date
expected_behavior: Bonus evaluation uses revised goal from effective date onward
known_failure_mode: original goal used for entire quarter trigger

name: Overlay rep assigned after deal close
description: Validate no retroactive overlay credit assignment
expected_behavior: Overlay credit starts only from assignment effective date

name: Negative balance exceeds draw amount
description: Validate payout floor behavior when negative balance exceeds draw
expected_behavior: System floors payout at zero and carries remaining negative balance per policy
known_failure_mode: negative payout issued instead of flooring at zero
